title: IT Auditor
summary: An IT auditor checks that a company's systems have the right controls and follow the rules, then reports what is missing. They sit in an internal audit or risk team, or a consultancy, testing IT general controls against standards like ISO 27001 and SOX and regulators like the RBI and SEBI.
dailyDuties: Plan audits and agree scope with control owners
Test IT general controls over access, change and operations
Assess IT risk and rate control deficiencies
Check systems against ISO 27001, COBIT, SOX and RBI frameworks
Write audit reports and agree remediation actions
Follow up on open findings until they are closed

skills.expectation: Plan and run IT general controls and application control testing
Audit against ISO 27001, SOC 2, COBIT and NIST CSF
Assess IT risk and rate control deficiencies
Check controls against policy and governance standards
Test access provisioning, reviews and segregation of duties
Build workpapers, samples and findings trackers
Write audit reports and discuss findings with control owners
Apply RBI, SEBI and SOX expectations in financial services audits
Audit personal data handling against the DPDP Act
Audit backup, DR and continuity arrangements

certifications.why: The core information systems audit credential
